Phase: Comments and moderation Status: Complete — accepted, public enablement remains a Phase 6 gate Implementation snapshot: 2026-07-31 Starting commit: fefd18e

This is the accepted Phase 5 record. It implements responsible flat public paper discussion and its complete in-product safety boundary. It does not represent the feature as publicly enabled: Phase 6 still owns end-to-end account deletion, hosted legal/support pages, retention/restore, telemetry and alerts, store review, and signed release-candidate controls, so both comment flags and especially public comment creation remain off by default.

The intended product and wire behavior is recorded in Comments and moderation contract.

2026-08-01 gap-closure addendum: the generic “reports” wording in the original acceptance record covered comment reports only. Production v0.0 now also has a distinct user-report table, repeat-safe API, combined backlog metrics, dedicated operator list/inspect/resolve commands, account-deletion and backup coverage, and an explicit mobile Report user action. Reporting a user does not create a block or alter visibility. Repository tests cover this separation; the protected live two-user/store-review evidence must include the new action before public enablement.

The same closure replaces the dormant moderation seam with a runtime-selectable HTTPS adapter. Deterministic rules always run first; provider outages, invalid status/body/schema, redirects, and oversized responses hold the comment for review rather than publishing it. Helm mounts the distinct bearer credential only for the HTTP provider and binds its URL, timeout, Secret rotation, and reviewed API egress into the rollout contract. The admin CLI now authenticates the operator through an OIDC token with an explicit recent auth_time, requires the resolved local user UUID in a bounded deployment allowlist, and derives that UUID as the audited actor; callers cannot choose an actor label and an ordinary active account has no moderation permission.

2026-08-09 current-tree hardening addendum: the mobile comment boundary now adds a 6,000-UTF-16-code-unit pre-normalization resource ceiling and a 64-code-unit/64-scalar extended-grapheme-cluster ceiling, rejects lone surrogates and unsafe controls before persistence/transport, uses Unicode 17 NFKC parity vectors with the Rust authority, and counts larger accepted drafts in one debounced background isolate. Send and Save remain disabled while validation is pending or invalid; stale validation and draft-hydration results cannot enable or send a different visible body. Explicit-send preparation is atomic and retains the request ID for canonically equivalent retry intent while rotating it for a genuinely different canonical body. Dart formatting, full Flutter analysis, 49 focused model/repository/API/DAO/controller/widget tests, the Rust domain regression, and the Android native-SBOM contract checks passed on the current tree. This addendum does not retroactively change the 358-test 2026-07-31 acceptance snapshot below.

Implementation ledger

Required acceptance evidence

Backend and operational result

Migration 0008_comments_and_moderation.sql adds normalized comments, unique reports, durable blocks, community-policy acceptance, moderation audit, and the indexes needed for newest-first and operator queues. The transport-neutral comment service resolves exact create/report replays before charging limits, checks eligibility before provider work, then rechecks inside the final transaction. Edits use optimistic versions; private-resource edit/delete failures collapse to one public not-found response. Shared PostgreSQL buckets cover account, direct-origin, mutation, report, and per-target report pressure. The API accepts forwarding metadata only from configured ingress-proxy source ranges, resolves the chain right-to-left, and HMACs the canonical client address with a validated owner-only secret before persistence.

COMMENTS_ENABLED registers public reads and safety routes; COMMENT_CREATION_ENABLED rejects only new posts. Comment limits are asserted against the domain constants at startup, rules and the bounded HTTPS runtime adapter are the only accepted moderation providers, and a real environment-safe support URL is mandatory. Deterministic high risk, provider uncertainty, and provider outage hold content privately. The audited pakperk-admin binary exposes content-free queues and metrics; only its explicit inspect command serializes one selected body/report.

Mobile and identity result

Drift schema version 5 stores bounded comment pages separately for guest and each viewer, account/paper drafts with stable request IDs, and persisted block projections. All account-owned writes cross a serialized account-and-auth-epoch barrier shared with sign-out/account-switch cleanup. Network completions from a disposed controller or old identity cannot repopulate the next session. Drafts are never placed in the library outbox or sent after connectivity returns; an explicit Send is required on every attempt and a creation-disabled response retains the draft.

The paper control and deep-link routes expose guest reading, an explicit sign-in rationale, handle/Terms/Community onboarding, create/edit/delete, report/block, My Comments, and Blocked Users. Pending-review content is visible only to its author. Local block persistence wins before the remote request and filters immediately; reconciliation converges server state across API instances. The comment renderer is plain selectable text without HTML/Markdown execution or unsafe automatic linkification.

Checks and live acceptance evidence

The settled Phase 5 tree passed on 2026-07-31:

The live flow onboarded both accounts with the exact published 2026-07-31 Terms and Community Guidelines; created and exactly replayed one comment; rejected mismatched reuse; edited and rejected a stale version; replayed one canonical report; and demonstrated block/filter/unblock across independent API processes. A deterministic high-risk body stayed private to its author.

The same run exercised content-free admin queues, explicit inspect, hide/restore, report resolution, suspend/reinstate, and the complete five-action audit trail. A creation-disabled API still served guest comments and papers, report/block, and author edit/repeat-safe delete. A third API with unavailable Keycloak kept guest paper/comment GETs healthy while authenticated access failed closed. Paper processing/job state was byte-for-byte unchanged. Three captured API logs contained none of the UGC, protected-header, full bearer, or token-signature sentinels. All disposable provider/local users, comments, reports, blocks, moderation events, rate buckets, and paper data were removed.

After that recorded run, the repository acceptance boundary was strengthened with a dedicated public PKCE pakperk-admin-dev client/audience and a manual, environment-gated, exact-main workflow. The updated harness requires separate negative checks for a valid mobile/API-audience token and a valid but non-allowlisted admin-audience identity before using an allowlisted operator. It emits only closed-schema, sanitized, disposable-reference evidence and tears down a unique Compose project with its volumes. The updated workflow and Docker flow were not run for this report; validator success proves the repository contract only. Its manual_ci_disposable_reference classification does not attest hosted environment protection, and its reference-sha256: ID cannot satisfy production Helm moderationReadinessId, which still requires protected staging evidence.

Remaining Phase 6 launch gates

  • In-app and web account deletion, provider identity erasure, recent-auth, retention, and restore-safe deletion ledger are not claimed by this phase.
  • The checked legal/support text still requires public HTTPS hosting, monitored operator details, qualified review, and store disclosure sign-off.
  • Simulator/debug native builds do not replace protected production signing, physical-device safety/accessibility flows, TestFlight/Play review, or RC telemetry.
  • Consequently, public comment creation remains off until the Phase 6 policy gate is explicitly accepted. The canonical Production v0.0 plan and its cross-phase scenarios remain authoritative.

阶段： 评论与内容审核 状态： 已完成 — 已接受；公开启用仍是 Phase 6 门禁 实施快照： 2026-07-31 起始提交： fefd18e

这是已接受的第 5 阶段记录。它实现了负责任的扁平化公开论文讨论及其完整的产品内安全边界。它并不表示该功能已公开启用：Phase 6 仍负责端到端账户删除、托管的法务/支持页面、保留/恢复、遥测和告警、商店审核以及签名的发布候选版本控制，因此评论开关尤其是公开评论创建默认保持关闭。

预期的产品与传输行为记录在评论与内容审核技术契约中。

**2026-08-01 补漏附录：原验收记录中的泛称“举报”仅涵盖评论举报。Production v0.0 现在还拥有独立的用户举报表、可安全重复的 API、合并的积压指标、专用的操作人员 list/inspect/resolve 命令、账户删除和备份覆盖，以及显式的移动端“举报用户”**操作。举报用户不会创建屏蔽，也不会改变可见性。仓库测试覆盖了这一区分；受保护的真实双用户/商店评审证据必须在公开启用前包含新操作。

同一收口用运行时可选择的 HTTPS 适配器取代了休眠的内容审核接缝。确定性规则始终最先运行；提供商中断、无效的状态/正文/schema、重定向和过大的响应都会将评论保留待审而不是发布。Helm 仅为 HTTP 提供商挂载独立的 Bearer 凭据，并将其 URL、超时、Secret 轮换和经评审的 API 出站流量绑定到分阶段发布契约中。管理 CLI 现在通过带有显式近期 auth_time 的 OIDC 令牌认证操作人员，要求解析出的本地用户 UUID 位于有界的部署允许列表中，并将该 UUID 派生为被审计的操作者；调用方无法选择操作者标签，普通活跃账户也没有内容审核权限。

**2026-08-09 当前代码树加固附录：**移动端评论边界现在新增了规范化前 6,000 个 UTF-16 代码单元的资源上限和 64 代码单元/64 标量的扩展字素簇上限，会在持久化/传输前拒绝孤立代理项和不安全控制字符，使用与 Rust 权威实现一致的 Unicode 17 NFKC 一致性向量，并在一个去抖动的后台 isolate 中统计较大的已接受草稿。校验待定或无效时，发送和保存保持禁用；过期的校验和草稿恢复结果无法启用或发送不同的可见正文。显式发送的准备是原子性的，并为规范等价的重试意图保留请求 ID，同时为真正不同的规范正文轮换该 ID。Dart 格式化、完整 Flutter 分析、49 项聚焦的 model/repository/API/DAO/controller/widget 测试、Rust 领域回归以及 Android native-SBOM 契约检查均已在当前代码树通过。本附录不会追溯改变下文中 358 项测试的 2026-07-31 验收快照。

实施台账

要求的验收证据

后端与运营结果

迁移 0008_comments_and_moderation.sql 新增规范化评论、唯一举报、持久屏蔽、社区政策接受、内容审核审计，以及最新优先和操作人员队列所需的索引。与传输无关的评论服务会在扣减限额前解析完全一致的创建/举报重放，在提供商工作前检查资格，然后在最终事务内再次检查。编辑使用乐观版本；私有资源的编辑/删除失败会合并为一个公开的未找到响应。共享 PostgreSQL 桶覆盖账户、直接来源、写操作、举报和按目标的举报压力。API 只接受来自已配置入站代理源范围的转发元数据，从右到左解析链路，并在持久化前使用经过验证的仅限所有者密钥对规范客户端地址进行 HMAC 运算。

COMMENTS_ENABLED 注册公开读取和安全路由；COMMENT_CREATION_ENABLED 只拒绝新发帖。评论限制会在启动时针对领域常量进行断言，rules 和有界的 HTTPS 运行时适配器是仅被接受的内容审核提供商，并且必须配置真实且环境安全的支持 URL。确定性的高风险、提供商不确定和提供商中断都会将内容私有保留。经审计的 pakperk-admin 二进制暴露不含内容的队列和指标；只有其显式的 inspect 命令会序列化一条选定的正文/举报。

移动端与身份结果

Drift schema 版本 5 为访客和每个查看者分别存储有界的评论页面、带稳定请求 ID 的账户/论文草稿，以及持久化的屏蔽投影。所有归账户所有的写入都会经过与退出登录/切换账户清理共享的串行化账户与认证纪元屏障。来自已释放控制器或旧身份的网络完成无法重新填充下一个会话。草稿绝不会进入论文库待同步队列（outbox），也不会在连接恢复后发送；每次尝试都需要显式的发送操作，禁用创建的响应会保留草稿。

论文控件和深层链接路由会呈现访客阅读、显式的登录理由、用户名/条款/社区引导、创建/编辑/删除、举报/屏蔽、我的评论和已屏蔽用户。待审内容仅对其作者可见。本地屏蔽持久化先于远程请求生效并立即过滤；对账会让服务器状态在各个 API 实例间收敛。评论渲染器是纯可选择文本，没有 HTML/Markdown 执行或不安全的自动链接识别。

检查与真实验收证据

已定稿的 Phase 5 代码树于 2026-07-31 通过：

真实流程使用确切发布的 2026-07-31 条款和社区准则引导了两个账户；创建并完全一致地重放了一条评论；拒绝不匹配的复用；编辑并拒绝过期版本；重放一个规范举报；并演示了跨独立 API 进程的屏蔽/过滤/取消屏蔽。确定性的高风险正文仅对其作者保持私有。

同一运行还演练了不含内容的管理队列、显式检查、隐藏/恢复、举报处置、封禁/恢复资格，以及完整的五操作审计轨迹。禁用创建的 API 仍然服务访客评论和论文、举报/屏蔽，以及作者编辑/可安全重复的删除。第三个 Keycloak 不可用的 API 让访客论文/评论 GET 保持健康，而认证访问则在失败时默认拒绝。论文处理/作业状态逐字节未变。三份捕获的 API 日志不含任何 UGC、受保护标头、完整 Bearer 或令牌签名哨兵值。所有一次性的提供商/本地用户、评论、举报、屏蔽、内容审核事件、限流桶和论文数据都被移除。

在该记录的运行之后，仓库验收边界通过专用的公开 PKCE pakperk-admin-dev 客户端/受众以及手动、环境门禁、精确 main 的工作流得到加强。更新后的测试工具要求先对有效的移动端/API 受众令牌和有效但不在允许列表中的管理受众身份执行单独的负面检查，然后才使用允许列表中的操作人员。它只输出闭合 schema、脱敏、一次性参考证据，并连同卷一起拆除唯一的 Compose 项目。更新后的工作流和 Docker 流程未在本报告中运行；验证器成功只证明仓库技术契约。其 manual_ci_disposable_reference 分类不能证明托管环境保护，其 reference-sha256: ID 也无法满足生产 Helm moderationReadinessId，后者仍要求受保护的预发布环境证据。

剩余的 Phase 6 上线门禁

  • 应用内与网页账户删除、提供商身份抹除、近期认证、保留和恢复安全的删除台账不由本阶段声称完成。
  • 已检入的法务/支持文本仍需要公开 HTTPS 托管、受监控的操作人员详情、合格评审和商店披露签核。
  • 模拟器/调试原生构建不能替代受保护的生产签名、真机安全/无障碍流程、TestFlight/Play 评审或 RC 遥测。
  • 因此，在 Phase 6 策略门禁被显式接受之前，公开评论创建保持关闭。规范的 Production v0.0 计划及其跨阶段场景仍然是权威依据。
